dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin is on a week-long tear, skyrocketing from $0.15 to $0.43 within days to mark its highest value in more than three years.

Source:
https://t.co/3A0q0qnBWY

Dogecoin (DOGE) continued its strong rally for the fourth-straight day with a 48% price jump over the past 24 hours, reigniting murmurs of a $1 price target.

Source:

https://t.co/KVEKaXzMkN

Dogecoin (DOGE), the largest memecoin by market cap, dropped below a short-term uptrend line on Monday, signaling an end to the recovery from December lows and potentially the conclusion of a five-month rally.
